description: Source code for the Packager plugin implementation in WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and connection management.

classes.name: Packager
classes.description: Main class implementing the packager plugin functionality, including lifecycle management and request processing.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the packager plugin with the provided service, sets up internal state and creates the package instance.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and terminates remote connections associated with the plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently returns an empty string.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently empty.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests directed to the packager, handling install and repository synchronization commands.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation events, triggering plugin deactivation procedures.
